double_counting_guard: Collapse/disappearance is represented by Forecast state probability; within-state production spread represents conditional production uncertainty. Simulation samples from these once.
forecast_emission_if_future_candidate_ea: within-state distribution metadata sufficient to reconstruct conditional quantiles or sample support
provenance/support metadata including training cutoff and effective sample size
overall expected points and uncertainty summaries derived from the same distribution
simulation_consumption: sample future state exactly once from Forecast state probabilities
if positive state, sample one production realization from the Forecast-provided within-state distribution
do not apply a second collapse haircut or independent RB downside multiplier
value_consumption: do not create an additional collapse penalty already represented in Forecast
retain Value authority for economic mapping rather than probabilistic outcome generation
